{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_neg1_count = (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {age_neg1_count}")

# Check revenue dtype and sample
print(f"Revenue dtype: {data['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample of revenue values: {data['revenue'].head(10).tolist()}")

# Check for test orders
test_orders_count = (data['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {test_orders_count}")

# Check status values
print(f"Unique values in status: {data['status'].unique()}")

# Print total rows
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")"}
